model_scope.position_order: P1=top-left, P2=top-right, P3=bottom-left, P4=bottom-right in the four-assembly quarter-core layout; verify against each generated geometry before interpreting results

state_variables.U: UO2 benchmark material identifier in the generated OpenMC model
state_variables.M: MOX benchmark material identifier in the generated OpenMC model

model_scope.constraint: Exactly two M and two U across four positions
explicit_non_claims: This abstraction is not the canonical full C5G7 benchmark unless all geometry, materials, boundary conditions, and specifications match the benchmark.
UO2/MOX labels are material classes, not burnup states.
No absolute power, safety, or physically optimal layout claim is made.

required_position_map.P1: top-left assembly position; confirm against generated lattice XML and candidate manifest
required_position_map.P2: top-right assembly position; confirm against generated lattice XML and candidate manifest
required_position_map.P3: bottom-left assembly position; confirm against generated lattice XML and candidate manifest
required_position_map.P4: bottom-right assembly position; confirm against generated lattice XML and candidate manifest

required_state_to_material_map.U: The exact UO2 material ID and nuclide-density vector loaded by the generated OpenMC model; populate from generated materials.xml and source specification
required_state_to_material_map.M: The exact selected C5G7 MOX material ID/enrichment and nuclide-density vector loaded by the generated OpenMC model; populate from generated materials.xml and source specification

required_material_compositions_source.primary: C5G7 benchmark specification, NEA/NSC/DOC(2001)4; verify exact tables and material definitions against the model actually used

required_cross_section_provenance.note: A matching hash proves file identity, not scientific correctness or agreement with the benchmark tables.

required_reference_comparison_protocol.reference: Use only a published/reference solution for the same benchmark configuration; if the four-position layout modifies the canonical case, call this a verification/reference comparison, not benchmark validation.
required_reference_comparison_protocol.acceptance_criteria: Must be predeclared from the applicable reference and uncertainty budget; no study-specific k-effective acceptance band is currently approved.

legacy_burnup_states.reason: These states cannot be equated to UO2/MOX material classes without traceable isotopic compositions and depletion/irradiation history.
